heading: Genre
about: The tag on the file, as its own library wrote it.

heading: BPM
about: Tempo, from the analyser. Blank until it has run.

heading: Key
about: Camelot — the notation you mix by.

heading: Loud
about: Integrated loudness in LUFS — how loud it is mastered, not how hard it hits.

heading: Energy
about: How hard it hits: percussive drive, how much the spectrum moves, and how                  little it breathes. Not how loud it is.

heading: Vocal
about: Whether there is a lead sitting where a singer sits, at the record's most vocal moment. A centred synth lead reads the same way.

heading: Phrase
about: How many beats a phrase runs for, when the structure is clear enough to say.

heading: Plays
about: How many times you have played it.

heading: Ready
about: Whether it has everything sync and harmonic mixing need.
